results.title: Gateway introspection surface
results.desc: GetGatewayInfo returns status, version, drivers, extensions
results.detail: grpc=0; status=1 (enum healthy, not string); gateway_version=0.1.6-rhaiv.2; compute_driver=kubernetes (openshell.compute.contract); extensions: kubernetes/compute, vault/credentials (openshell.credentials.contract), regex/supervisor-middleware; body=441B
results.prose: GetGatewayInfo is the surface every client bootstraps from, so I dumped its full response. My first assertion was wrong — I looked for the string 'Healthy' but status is a protobuf enum (value 1), a nice reminder to read the schema before asserting. The call returns service status, gateway version 0.1.6-rhaiv.2, the kubernetes compute driver with its contract, and three negotiated extensions: kubernetes compute, a vault-backed credentials driver, and a regex supervisor middleware. Full coherent introspection surface, which is what the REST/WS alignment (#5336) and OTLP gating (#5348) work depends on.
steps: parse response for status, version pattern, driver/extension fields.
